mapper.sql: sys30_leave_year_id AS leave_year_id, sys30_company_id AS company_id, CAST(sys30_year AS varchar) AS year, CAST(sys30_leave_days AS varchar) AS leave_days
mapper.select: SELECT sys01_company_id AS company_id, sys01_leave_yn AS leave_yn, sys01_leave_month_cd AS leave_month_code, f_cdnm('MonthsCode', sys01_leave_month_cd, sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS leave_month_name FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT FROM sys30_leave_year WHERE sys30_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sys30_year
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys30_leave_year (sys30_leave_year_id, sys30_company_id, sys30_year, sys30_leave_days) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, CAST(#{req.year} AS numeric), CAST(#{req.leaveDays} AS numeric))
